_: A production of “Mate in Three Moves” by the hand of Tarkovsky — the “film image”: photographic layers in a 3D scene (styles/tarkovsky-film.json), long takes, pauses, the elements (directors/tarkovsky.json in the storyboard). Text, translation and voice come from the base story (base); its own — the bible, storyboard, assets, build.
art_context: Provincial Russian town, around 1908, as remembered in a Tarkovsky film: a rainy summer evening, a young doctor's modest consulting room with an electric desk lamp, rain on the window, damp walls; memories of a hot dusty summer street, a garden at night under the stars, a dark bedroom. Clothing and objects of the Russian Empire, 1900s. No anachronisms.
